headline: Oil Prices Surge on Geopolitical Tensions
detail: Brent crude jumped above $90 due to U.S.-Iran hostilities. Higher oil prices can signal inflation concerns, potentially pressuring tech stocks that are sensitive to interest rate expectations.
rec: Monitor oil prices and inflation data. No direct action on holdings based on this headline alone, but it adds to market uncertainty.

headline: Crypto Exchange Gemini Cleared in Earn Program Collapse
detail: An arbitrator found Gemini not at fault for the collapse of its Earn lending program. This is positive for crypto sentiment, potentially benefiting related digital asset plays.
rec: This headline is not directly relevant to your tech/chip concentration. No action needed on your current holdings.

headline: Scanner Long Setups Identified
